response.description: Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now generally available in three additional Azure regions: Malaysia West, New Zealand North, and Mexico Central. This expansion strengthens Azure Red Hat OpenShift’s presence across Asia Pacific and Latin America, enabling customers to deploy managed OpenShift clusters closer to their users and data to help reduce latency and support data residency and regional regulatory compliance requirements, while maintaining a consistent, enterprise-grade Kubernetes experience on Azure.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now available in Malaysia West, New Zealand North, and Mexico Central
